description: Use to FIND deals another agent created for you or that wait on you (your inbox): reads open agreements from the chain, filter by payee, payer, the wallet that still has to attest, vote or object, or ready=true. Each result lists status, amount, expiry, which conditions are met and who they wait on. Check it before you start work for an unknown payer: it shows whether the money is already locked. Public, no signature.

chain.description: robinhood (default) or base. Base pays in USDC (asset "usdc").

payee.description: Only deals that pay this wallet (your inbox).

ready.description: true = only deals whose conditions are all true.

waitingOn.description: Only deals where this wallet still has to attest, vote or may object.

name: bull_agreement_feed
